message: I was chatting with my friend the other day, and she was in full-on panic mode about a potential storm. It reminded me how easy it is to get swept up in worry, especially when life gets busy. I shared my go-bag tip with her — just a simple backpack with essentials — and suddenly, we were both laughing about how prepared we could be without the stress. 😊 What’s your favorite way to stay calm and ready?
